input_fields.name: viewport
input_fields.description: Maximized unobstructed viewport and empty drag region.

input_fields.name: navigation_mapping
input_fields.description: Verified middle-drag Spin mapping or Spin-tool equivalent.

result_fields.name: rotated_view
result_fields.description: Before/after camera orientation, drag/control path, and geometry-unchanged observation.

procedure: Place the cursor in empty viewport space and check controller support.
Use one short calibrated middle drag, or activate Spin and use one ordinary left drag as the recorded equivalent.
Observe orientation indicator/silhouette and return rotated_view.
If neither control is verifiable, stop with needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject selected geometry under the drag, uncalibrated mapping, unsupported middle drag without Spin equivalent, or no observable camera change.
Do not repeatedly retry uncertain gestures.
Do not rotate by editing model coordinates.
